authored_canonical_changes.old: Could our universe be inside a black hole? It's a question we were personally curious about — a side-interest, not part of the lab's research programme. We read the original scientific papers to see what they actually predict. One of these ideas gives us a number we can check against real stars. For galaxy spin, the sources give no expected size for the effect, and even a perfect measurement couldn't tell us a black hole was the cause. So this route closes. The idea is not declared true or false.
